Can India Break China’s Monopoly on Rare Earth Magnets?
India is trying to build its own rare earth magnet manufacturing industry to reduce dependence on Chinese imports. The government has launched a ₹7,280 crore incentive scheme to support domestic production of high-performance neodymium magnets, which are essential for electric vehicles, wind turbines and defence equipment.
